did_you_know: In the story Saint Jerome encounters a fearsome lion, here depicted as diminutive, gentle, and submissive.
artlens_description:
INTERACTIVE
Examine this artwork with Look Closer
Use the interactive lens to see the intricate details of this alabaster statue up close and listen to the sculpture’s hidden stories.
description:
This statue shows an important moment from a story about Saint Jerome. One day Jerome encountered a hurt lion. He removed a thorn from its paw, and the grateful animal became Jerome’s lifelong companion.

This sculpture is made of alabaster, a soft stone suited for carving fine detail. Look closely! You can see flecks of paint and gold from when it was originally painted. Conservators looked at this sculpture under a microscope and found that the lion once had a red mouth, yellow fur, and black claws.
